name: Text Expander Lite
privacy: All snippets and variables are stored locally. No cloud account, telemetry, or PackRat service is required.
listing_summary: Save reusable text snippets and insert dynamic text from Stream Deck. Lite supports up to 10 local snippets plus {date}, {time}, and {clipboard}, with Unicode, emoji, multiline text, URLs, and code snippets.
pro_url_rule: Do not show a Pro Marketplace button until the real Text Expander Pro listing URL has been created and verified.
release_gate: locked dependency install and deterministic build
high-severity runtime dependency audit with patched ws 8.21.0

37 automated Windows tests covering native Win32 INPUT sizing, live insertion, common Pro date/time formats, variables, Unicode, persistence, corruption recovery, counters, local templates, reserved variables, stale snippet repair, library-manager refresh, Lite/Pro storage isolation, lazy PI transport, clipboard hardening, schema-v3 migration, semantic/no-rail key visuals, and Full Library profile placement
bundled Stream Deck profile archive structural validation
shared Stream Deck key-face visual audit with 0 errors/warnings plus manual 72x72 and 36x36 review
official Stream Deck SDK v2 / SDKVersion 3
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art search icon, cover, and four distinct gallery frames
real Windows insertion smoke in Notepad, browser, Discord, multiline editor, and code editor
clipboard restoration and blocked-synthetic-input fallback smoke
final_boundary: Run plugins/text-expander/REAL_WINDOWS_SMOKE.md against the validated package bytes recorded in automated_release_evidence. Stage/publish Pro first; once its direct Marketplace URL is verified, add it to products/lite-pro-map.json, rebuild/revalidate Lite so its upgrade button becomes live, then ship Lite.
